the virtual clinic, or the virtual world of SOME, is a place where the most credible argument wins the day and that the most credible arguments are those that are based on the most credible evidence and that the most reliable evidence is the evidence that is based on the most reliable facts.

the psychological and social implications of the cyber world, especially SOME, and its role as a new kind of Agora for human identity formation, where the struggle between the individual and the social human is fought.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cyber world, as a virtual Agora or mental battle space, is a place of psychological struggle where the most credible arguments are used to win over the most intolerant ego-fortresses.
the virtual world of Facebook and SOME is not a place of peace and harmony, but rather a place for the clash between different ideas and opinions.

the cyber world is an ideal place for a mental battle against intolerant and authoritarian world views and that the best way to do it is to form an alliance of credible and emancipatory minded people, who would be ready to defend their ideas in cyber world.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the cyber world is not a place of utopian dreams, but rather a place of mental battles between the ego and the world and between different egos, where the ego is the one, who is in the position to influence others and the world.
the world is not black and white, but gray and gray.

we have found that the cyber space is a new, virtual “clinic” for human beings, where the most important “treatments” are the most credible arguments, and where the most important medicines are the most credible ideas.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the virtual “clinic” is not the place for the weak of heart, but for the brave, who are ready to fight for their beliefs, but also for the tolerance of the beliefs of the others, and for the tolerance of others’ right of free speech, even if it may hurt.
cyber discussions are not a new form of human communication, but rather an extension of human communication into the digital space.
cyber is more than technology and it is also more than just a virtual space.
